summary: LSU hosts Mississippi State, whose starting quarterback and top running back are both doubtful. The line moved from about LSU -10 to -17.5.

legs.note: LSU is 4-0 at home and Mississippi State is likely without its starting quarterback and top running back.

legs.desc: Mississippi State Bulldogs team total Under 19.5
legs.note: Mississippi State loses its quarterback and lead running back against an LSU defense that allows 47.5 rushing yards a game.
Mississippi State's offense is downgraded and LSU should run the ball with a lead, but the total already dropped about 3 points.
Kiffin has covered about 62% as a big favorite and the quarterback drop-off is severe, but this is roughly fair.

research:
1. QBs/personnel: MSST QB Kamario Taylor (2026 freshman starter) has 1,192 pass yds, 69.2% completions, 14 TD / 2 INT, and 185 rush yds through Missouri (ESPN via search, WTVA, WLOX). He threw 354/4 TD vs ULM and 360/3 TD/1 INT vs Missouri, then struggled vs Alabama (55.9%, 2 INT) while hurt. Backups: Parker 'Billy' Puckett is a Jackson Prep preferred walk-on (61.6%, 2,484 yds, 22 TD as an HS junior) who is 8-of-14 for 89 yds in 2026 (Clutchpoints/RotoBaller). AJ Swann has 24 career games and 18 starts: Vanderbilt 2022-23 (56.3%, 2,731 yds, 22 TD / 9 INT), LSU 2024 (2-of-4), App State 2025 (59%, 1,498 yds, 10 TD / 8 INT) (Wikipedia, SI, Hail State). Lebby said both could play. LSU QB Sam Leavitt (ex-Arizona State) passes for about 244-261 ypg; he went 25/34, 275 yds, 1-2 TD, 1 INT, 1 fumble, and 39 rush yds at Kentucky (AP, LSUsports.net), with 3 INTs vs La Tech. LSU's rushing is led by Dilin Jones over Caden Durham (2025: 505 yds, 4.5 ypc).
2. Injuries (Fri/Sat): ESPN's Pete Thamel and the SEC availability report have Taylor (turf toe from Missouri, aggravated vs Alabama) downgraded from questionable to doubtful and not expected to play. RB Fluff Bothwell (lower leg; 403 yds on 74 carries) is doubtful, with Kolin Wilson next (ESPN, TigerRag, RotoBaller). LSU has ruled out TE Trey'Dez Green, LB Whit Weeks (broken leg), S Dashawn Spears, WR Phillip Wright III, and LB Charles Ross II; LB Tylen Singleton is questionable/doubtful (TigerDroppings, SI). The final report comes 90 minutes before kickoff.
3. Advanced stats: Preseason SP+ ranks LSU 10th (20.2) and MSST 52nd (Saturday Down South/ESPN); no in-season SP+ was found. Game on Paper adjusted EPA ranks LSU 3rd and MSST 24th (via Predictem). LSU's run defense allows 47.5 ypg (2nd nationally through week 4, Roundtable), and its rushing offense gains 237.8 ypg (15th, Roundtable, Oct 6), up from 104 ypg in 2025. MSST's defense was last in the SEC in 2024 (34.1 ppg) and second-to-last in 2025; DC Zach Arnett is new in 2026 (WLOX). No 2026 havoc, red-zone, or third-down splits were found.
4. Scheme: Kiffin's tempo RPO/run-heavy offense faces an Arnett 3-3-5-style MSST defense that returned both starting DTs and has run-stopped surprisingly well (Sharp Football). Ole Miss was the one team to shred LSU (363 pass yds), so the LSU secondary is beatable by an elite passer, which MSST no longer has. The MSST OL allowed 5 sacks vs Alabama, and LSU averages nearly 4 sacks a game (Predictem).
5. Coaching: Kiffin covered about 62% as a 7+ point favorite over roughly 50 games (Saturday Down South, career trends), but LSU is just 2-4 ATS in 2026 (FanDuel/SportsGambler). Kiffin keeps his foot on the gas in blowouts. Lebby (MSST, 3rd year) calls his own up-tempo plays and is now limited by the QB situation.
6. Situational: Noon ET ESPN kickoff, so no night Death Valley bump. LSU comes off a 35-34 OT loss at Kentucky (Oct 10) in a bounce-back home spot and is 4-0 at home. MSST comes off a bye after the Oct 3 56-23 loss at Alabama; it is 4-1 and has won both road games (Minnesota, South Carolina). The rankings are #16 MSST and #22 LSU per FLM, so MSST got a ranking boost from its 4-0 start.
7. History: LSU leads 75-36-3. The last meeting was LSU 41-14 in 2023 (Wikipedia), and LSU has won 15 of 16 from 2000-2023 (CBS). MSST's recent wins came in 2017 and 2020.
8. Weather: No dated forecast was found (WAFB/WBRZ searches returned older items). Mid-October Baton Rouge at noon is typically low-to-mid 80s, and the prior pass found a cold front this weekend with rain holding off until night. Assume a neutral, dry day game.
9. Experts/market: Dimers projects 36-24 LSU (81%, at -11.5); numberFire 83.8% LSU; Predictem LSU -14; VegasInsider (Dylan Wilkerson) LSU -14.5, 'LSU gets back on track'; SportsGambler Over 56.5; YouWager LSU 34-27 with MSST +10 or better; A to Z Sports split. Prediction markets are 80/20 and FPI is 76.9%. Nearly all came before the Taylor downgrade. The line went from about -10 to -14.5 on the questionable news (Yahoo) and to -17.5 after the doubtful news; the total went from 58.5-59.5 to 56; the ML is now -800. No 2026 bet/money split data was found.
